definitions.explanation: Paper used to wrap gifts or products. In Japan, stores typically offer wrapping paper for purchases that are intended as gifts.

examples.japanese: プレゼントを{包装紙|ほうそうし}で{包|つつ}んだ。
examples.english: I wrapped the present in wrapping paper.

examples.japanese: きれいな{包装紙|ほうそうし}を{選|えら}んでください。
examples.english: Please choose a nice wrapping paper.

examples.japanese: {百貨店|ひゃっかてん}では{商品|しょうひん}を{買|か}うと{無料|むりょう}で{包装紙|ほうそうし}に{包|つつ}んでくれる。
examples.english: At department stores, they wrap your purchases in wrapping paper for free.

notes:
Paper used to wrap gifts or purchases. In Japanese culture, presentation matters greatly, and wrapping is considered part of the gift.

FORMS:
{包装|ほうそう} (wrapping, packaging) + {紙|し} (paper).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {包装紙|ほうそうし}で{包|つつ}む: to wrap in wrapping paper
- {包装紙|ほうそうし}を{破|やぶ}る: to tear open wrapping paper
- {包装紙|ほうそうし}を{選|えら}ぶ: to choose wrapping paper

CULTURAL NOTE:
Department stores ({百貨店|ひゃっかてん}) and specialty shops typically offer free gift-wrapping. Each store often has its own signature {包装紙|ほうそうし}, which can signal where the gift was purchased.
